About the Role 

Role: AI & Operations Associate 

Type: Full Time 

Location: Required to be in office in Boulder, CO 4 days a week (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) with 1 Flex Day (Friday). Occasional after-hours and weekend work may be required. 

Start Date: Immediate 

Compensation: $65–110k plus benefits




Job Description 

Caruso Ventures is seeking a technically capable and entrepreneurial AI & Operations Associate to develop and apply AI expertise across our firm and portfolio companies, helping both Caruso Ventures and the founders we back fully leverage AI in their operations, products, and decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, automation, and portfolio operations, ideal for a hands-on builder who has shipped and maintained production software and AI-enabled workflows, curious about startups and venture capital, and eager to build tools and processes that make our organization and the ones we support more efficient and insightful. You'll join a small, fast-moving team where your contributions will span from building AI workflows to streamlining internal processes, assisting with firm-wide initiatives (from coordinating events to portfolio analysis), and collaborating with portfolio companies to help them implement AI solutions, optimize workflows, and prototype new tools. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves solving problems with data, code, and creativity. Caruso Ventures, LLC is a growing, entrepreneurial organization operating as a single-family office and tech investment fund. This position is ideal for an independent product-minded builder who can own systems from discovery through deployment, monitoring, and iteration with an interest in both technology and venture capital, someone eager to learn how AI can enhance how a fund sources deals, supports founders, and runs operations.

Build, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications end to end, including the underlying APIs, databases, integrations, and deployment infrastructureDesign and implement AI-powered tools to automate tasks and workflows across Caruso Ventures, from data collection and analysis to communications and content creationEvaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agents, APIs, workflow tools) that enhance team productivityBuild custom dashboards and reporting tools to improve visibility across investments, portfolio performance, and internal operations


Operations & Efficiency

Provide launch and on-site technical support when required, in partnership with the program owner.Use AI and automation tools to streamline event planning, track RSVPs, generate materials, and manage post-event follow-upsContribute to the creation of content (newsletters, presentations, internal briefings) using AI-assisted toolsServe as a resource for AI literacy and experimentation across the organization


Venture & Research Support

Support deal flow by leveraging AI to research companies, synthesize market trends, and track sector activityPrepare internal memos, summaries, and insights to inform investment discussionsContribute to data-driven analyses that enhance strategic decision-making


Preferred Job Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related technical field.Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar coding agents to build and deploy full-stack applications from initial concept through production.Ability to understand, review, debug, and maintain AI-generated code, with working proficiency in TypeScript or Python, SQL, PostgreSQL/Supabase, relational data modeling, schema design and migrations, APIs, data pipelines, and modern full-stack application architecture.Strong product judgement: capable of owning a problem from idea to deployment, balancing technical depth with user needs and operational impact.Interest in startups, venture capital, and the evolving AI ecosystem.

You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact.


At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.


Your Role and Responsibilities As an Applied AI Specialist, you will drive the design, implementation, and management of AI-driven solutions that operationalize AI-first Application Management Services. This role involves collaboration with various stakeholders to deliver scalable, user-centric AI capabilities that automate workflows and improve service delivery, leveraging expertise in AI solution delivery and operational governance.


Your primary responsibilities will include:


  Solution Design: Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, user-centric AI capabilities that automate workflows, augment decision-making, and improve service delivery.


  AI Implementation: Implement and manage AI-driven solutions that integrate with observability, telemetry, event management, and operational monitoring platforms to enable intelligent automation and incident response.


  Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize agent performance through model evaluation, prompt refinement, agent configuration, and logic enhancements to improve accuracy, reliability, and business outcomes.


  Operational Governance: Maintain operational governance of AI solutions by managing production stability, performance thresholds, compliance requirements, risk controls, and responsible AI practices.


  Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with application operations, platform operations, engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders to design, deploy, and continuously improve agent-based solutions.


  This position can be performed from anywhere in the United States.
Required Education Bachelor's Degree

  AI Solution Delivery: Deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing AI-driven solutions that operationalize AI-first Application Management Services. Experience with translating business and operational requirements into scalable, user-centric AI capabilities.

 Preferred Technical and Professional Experience   Advanced AI Frameworks: Experience with utilizing Agentic AI frameworks to deliver scalable AI-enabled operations.

Role Title: AI Safety & Red Teaming Specialist


Role Type: Contractor


Location: Remote




We are looking for an experienced AI Safety & Red Teaming Specialist to help evaluate and strengthen the safety, security, and robustness of next-generation AI systems. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in adversarial AI, LLM security, and AI safety to identify vulnerabilities, design evaluation methodologies, and improve the resilience of large language models against real-world threats.




This opportunity is ideal for professionals passionate about AI security, ethical hacking, and developing robust evaluation frameworks for advanced AI systems.



Requirements

Key Responsibilities



 Design and implement advanced evaluation methodologies for AI system safety, including ethical jailbreak testing, prompt injection detection, LLM red teaming, and tool-use abuse scenarios.
 Develop cross-domain adversarial testing strategies to uncover complex, multi-turn attack patterns and model vulnerabilities.
 Build, maintain, and enhance regression test suites to continuously assess jailbreak susceptibility and prompt injection risks.
 Create comprehensive evaluation frameworks that simulate real-world adversarial threats to improve AI robustness and reliability.
 Collaborate with technical teams to translate security findings into actionable recommendations for AI safety improvements.
 Document testing methodologies, findings, and best practices through clear technical reports and presentations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Required Qualifications



 2+ years of experience in AI Safety, Adversarial Machine Learning, LLM Red Teaming, AI Security, or a related field.
 Hands-on experience researching, testing, or identifying vulnerabilities involving prompt injection, ethical jailbreaks, adversarial attacks, or tool-use exploitation.
 Strong understanding of modern LLM architectures, prompt engineering, and AI safety evaluation methodologies.
 Experience developing structured security assessments, regression testing frameworks, and adversarial evaluation strategies.
 Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical findings clearly.
 Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional technical teams.
Preferred Qualifications



 Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline.
 Contributions to AI security research, open-source AI safety tools, conference presentations, or published research.
 Experience with AI model evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering techniques, and AI security assessment tools.
 Background in multidisciplinary AI safety, cybersecurity, or adversarial machine learning projects.

jobs_results.job_title: AI Implementation Specialist / AI Agent Developer for Ecommerce Business — Ongoing Contract
jobs_results.description:
We’re Katia Designs, an established ecommerce jewelry brand seeking an experienced contractor to help build our AI architecture and deploy practical AI agents across the business.

You’ll work directly with the owner. Our goal is to reduce operating costs, improve visibility and accountability, and automate work currently performed manually. Where reliable and economically justified, we want AI agents to take over responsibilities currently handled by employees, contractors, or agencies.

What you’ll do

Assess our existing systems, integrations, data infrastructure, and workflows.

Identify which responsibilities can be fully automated, which need human oversight, and which should remain with people.

Build and deploy agents that complete business tasks, monitor results, and flag exceptions.

Continue developing our central data warehouse and connect reliable business data to our AI workflows.

Create documentation and train our team so we can operate and maintain what you build.

Initial priorities

Reporting and accountability: Consolidate channel results, identify missing reports, track commitments, and prepare weekly management briefings.

Ecommerce and marketing analysis: Monitor sales, advertising, promotions, margins, and conversion performance; surface issues and recommended actions.

Finance and expense oversight: Automate expense classification, recurring cost reviews, and profitability reporting.

Administrative workflows: Streamline email triage, invoice routing, task creation, and follow-ups.

We’ll select the first implementation together based on measurable savings, feasibility, and business impact.

Our environment

Our systems include Shopify, Google BigQuery, Windsor.ai, ChatGPT Business, Slack, Gmail, Google Workspace, Asana, QuickBooks Online, Gusto, Klaviyo, and advertising platforms. Some integrations are already in place; others need to be assessed, completed, or improved.

You do not need experience with every platform, but you must be comfortable integrating systems through APIs and working with an existing setup.

Required experience

Proven delivery of AI agents and automations used in real business operations.

Strong API integration, authentication, and data troubleshooting skills.

Python and/or JavaScript, SQL, and experience with cloud infrastructure.

Experience with OpenAI APIs and agent development.

Experience with tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier, with the judgment to know when custom code is needed.

Reliable implementation practices: testing, monitoring, error handling, access controls, and documentation.

Ability to explain technical decisions clearly to a business owner.

Ecommerce, BigQuery, Shopify, and financial reporting experience are strong advantages.

What success looks like

We want working systems with measurable results: fewer manual hours, lower recurring costs, more accurate reporting, and dependable execution.

Agents must use verified data, make failures visible, and require appropriate approval before sending external communications, changing budgets, or taking other consequential actions.

All code, workflows, accounts, credentials, and documentation must remain under company ownership and control.

Engagement

This is an ongoing contractor opportunity, starting with a paid assessment and one clearly scoped implementation milestone. Continued work will depend on results. Please propose a realistic initial scope and timeline.

To apply, please include:

Two relevant examples of agents or automations you personally built, including what they did and the measurable outcome.

Your role in those projects and the tools you used.

How you would assess our existing setup and prioritize the first 30 days.

How you decide whether a workflow is ready for full automation or needs human review.

Your hourly rate, weekly availability, time zone, and earliest start date.

Any expected software or infrastructure costs beyond your fee.

Please begin your proposal with “Katia AI Implementation” and describe one ecommerce workflow you have automated successfully.

We’re looking for someone who can build, troubleshoot, and maintain dependable systems—not simply provide strategy or prompt templates.
